        "Every owned hunk in all 106 paths and all 4,787 diff lines was read. The macOS preference addition is functional infrastructure and does not make this human patch a bulk exclusion. Whole exact prior current records/timestamps are reused after matching their receivers/ranges; no duplicate semantic credit is claimed for those unchanged current contracts.",
        "The patch also removes the old flags from Calendar menu#item-menu and SMTP menuitem#useDefaultItem, which were not popup elements. Their exact current target identities match the earlier scoped 4d277bb9ff7c3b44810d0c9fb683f88bba11ea5c3444e116a4a30c98aaff3e83 finding. This remains a source-target distinction; no engine effectiveness or runtime defect is inferred.",
        "The complete changed unified-toolbar test task was read. Removing two setup setters does not add a new native-mode assertion. Its existing direct assertions check that opening the main popup sets button.ariaPressed, closing only its submenu keeps that state, and closing the main popup removes it. Actual handleClick opens the referenced popup and its hiding listener returns while that popup remains open. All three assertion messages are non-empty and state the pressed-state expectation; missing should alone is not reported as a defect in this historical patch.",
        "A scoped accepted search across the same 106 paths finds one missing file (customizeMode.inc.xhtml) and one explicit native=false in the separate accentColor popup of appearance.inc.xhtml. Current fixture aria-label additions and other accepted changes remain separate. No claim is made that every menu annotation is removed, every historical file survives, or the accepted tree is an exact inverse of the earlier port.",
        "Both emitted owned diffs 4851/4855 were checked additively for conditional metadata after their body read; no Suite directives appeared. A further all-affected-path scan at parent/owned/accepted revisions found no Suite-specific preprocessor condition before new snapshots were exported. These receipts preserve the actual check timing and do not retroactively claim a before-read guard.",
        "Existing menu IDs, l10n names, commands, handler strings, popup positioning, classes and focus-related markup remain in the inspected changed hunks after the native flags are removed. Long flattened markup lines are formatting context, not invented readability defects. The author's no-functional-change AFAIK claim and possible extra affected place require their own attribution; no macOS, keyboard, screen-reader, menu-rendering or test execution occurred.",
        "Primary Bug 2022755 is complete through current 0–2, activity and end controls, originally read by Parent. The author reports advice to disable the preference rather than add native=false to individual menus and expects fewer future test breakages. D287220#9960679 is an unread advice locator, not additional accepted evidence here. Original Bug 2018249 remains a separately studied source phase; no external engine body was reopened.",
        "D287297 is complete from creation to landing with no actual inlines or summary edits. The reviewer explicitly cannot test on Mac and asks for later Daily/QA attention. The author qualifies the no-functional-change statement with AFAIK and an exception for one more place using non-native menus. Source establishes a macOS-only default plus removals across shared markup/runtime/fixtures, but cannot validate the untested global equivalence claim or identify a runtime cure.",
        "The Good Try/remote-build/acceptance/landing reports are historical. Reviewer-group removal is metadata, not a security finding. The full owned 106-path patch, changed test task, exact current constructions and source-identity reuses are reconciled; direct tests cover popup pressed state rather than native mode. No macOS, keyboard, accessible-tree, menu rendering or test run occurred."
